handbookNote: Batch 2 depth expansion for the Nevada Notary practice-question pool -- same source grounding as batch 1 (Nevada Revised Statutes Chapter 240 (Notaries Public and Commissioned Abstracters), including the Uniform Law on Notarial Acts at NRS 240.161-240.169 and the Electronic Notarization Enabling Act at NRS 240.181-240.206, plus implementing regulations at Nevada Administrative Code Chapter 240), going deeper into definitions, appointment disqualifications/mechanics, bond/stamp/amended-certificate lifecycle, the full fee schedule, journal recordkeeping detail, the statutory short forms (NRS 240.166-240.169, 240.1685, 240.19902), notarial acts performed by other officials/jurisdictions, satisfactory-evidence edge cases (senior citizens, incarcerated persons), prohibited-act and conflict-of-interest scenarios, discipline/hearing procedure (NAC 240.250, 240.400-240.540), and electronic-notary definitions/registration/audio-video/identity-proofing/journal-safeguard mechanics not covered by the first 66-question batch, plus scenario/application variants of already-covered rules using new fact patterns -- price matches this project's established Notary tier ($9.99, same as batch 1)
